title: looks_like_bcrypt_hash factored into stoa-auth is correct placement
description: looks_like_bcrypt_hash was previously duplicated in reader/config.rs. Moving it to stoa-auth ensures all three services (reader, imap, smtp) use the same validation logic and cost-range check. If a future contributor wants to tighten or relax the check, one change covers all services. Do not move it back to individual crates.
